remarks: Reviewing all offers, please submit all offers by 5pm Sunday. Enjoy in-town living in this fully updated immaculate townhouse in the heart of Stamford. With two bedrooms, two full baths, and an attached 1-car garage, this unit has over 1,300 square feet of living space. The large living room/dining room combo has hardwood floors and is filled with natural light. The updated eat-in-kitchen has granite countertops, stainless steel appliances with sliding doors to a large, private balcony. The ground level has an office/den with direct access to the garage. Additional features include central air, gas heat, washer/dryer and additional parking for one car. Convenient mid-city location is walkable to downtown Stamford as well as shopping, restaurants, Scalzi Park and Tully Health Center.  Excellent Credit, Income and References are a Must. Schedule your private showing today! **Also available fully furnished for $3,500/month.
